pattern: percentage-point change between two labelled rounds on messy headers, state filter, detail rows only
question: Bihar district wise full vaccination change from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5 in percentage points
gold_sql: SELECT "District", MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" END) - MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" END) AS change_pp FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "State" = 'Bihar' AND "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: SELECT d4.District, d5."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS nfhs5, d4."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS nfhs4, d5."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" - d4."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS change_in_percentage_points FROM district_health_factsheet AS d4 JOIN district_health_factsheet AS d5 ON d4.State = d5.State AND d4.District = d5.District AND d4."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' AND d5."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' WHERE d4.State = 'Bihar'
